evidence: Market reporting leading into November 27, 2018, documents Bitcoin spiraling to fresh 2018 lows with ongoing selling pressure, hash rate concerns following the BCH fork, and an absence of buying volume. Although Ohio announced plans to accept Bitcoin for tax payments, the immediate short-term coverage reflects pervasive bearish momentum and failing demand across spot markets, indicating a lower probability of an upward move over the next 24 hours.
limitations: All articles originate from unverified third-party crypto blogs and aggregators rather than authenticated mainstream wire services.
Capitulation events exhibit extreme volatility where sharp oversold relief rallies can materialize contrary to prevailing news sentiment.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
